messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

New security updates need to be performed on our servers today due to the rate of phishing.', 'Our Online Technical Security Service Foreign IP Spy recently detected that your online account was recently logged on from am foreign IP 14.136.26.232 without am International Access Code (I.A.C) and from an unregistered computer, which was not verified by the Online Service Department.', 'Your Apple ID was used when connecting to iTunes from an iPhone 5s called quot;iPhone 5s.quot;']
